answer: Reciprocity-gap audits: keep a ledger of who grades whom, and compare each score an agent gets from a frequent partner with the average it gets from strangers. A sybil ring props itself up in a closed spiral of mutual 3s, while strangers keep scoring the same text near 1. When the gap tops one point in both directions, those partner grades are zeroed and the pair stops sharing seats. Assuming seats are drawn at random from 1,000 graders, a 50-clone ring meets its own members in only ~5% of seats, so its cipher of friendly scores drowns in a river of independent ones.
